detail.description: Cronicle 是一个多服务器任务调度程序和运行程序，具有基于 Web 的前端 UI。在 0.9.121 之前，具有“create_events”和“run_events”权限的非管理员用户或作用域 API 密钥可以通过“/api/app/create_event”或“/api/app/update_event”注入顶级“uid”和“gid”字段。在“lib/api.js”中，“requireValidEventData”使用“validateOptionalParams”作为部分允许列表，默默地传递未知密钥，逐字存储注入的字段。在“lib/job.js”中，“launchJob”将整个事件复制到作业中，并且插件“uid”仅在插件定义事件“uid”时才覆盖事件“uid”。默认的“shellplug”和“urlplug”插件没有定义“uid”，因此事件控制的身份在子进程启动时仍然存在。在 root 守护程序安装中，这允许低权限用户以任意用户（包括 root）身份运行作业，从而绕过其他仅由管理员运行的用户控制。此 API 端事件注入与 CVE-2026-39401 解决的作业输出“uid”/“gid”注入不同。此问题已在版本 0.9.121 中修复。
detail.kind: 动态确定对象属性修改的控制不恰当
detail.kind_en: 动态确定的对象属性的受控修改不当
detail.title: CVE-2026-58255漏洞

detail_original.description: Cronicle is a multi-server task scheduler and runner, with a web based front-end UI. Prior to 0.9.121, a non-administrator user or scoped API key with `create_events` and `run_events` privileges can inject top-level `uid` and `gid` fields through `/api/app/create_event` or `/api/app/update_event`. In `lib/api.js`, `requireValidEventData` uses `validateOptionalParams` as a partial allow-list that silently passes unknown keys, storing the injected fields verbatim. In `lib/job.js`, `launchJob` copies the whole event into the job, and a plugin `uid` overrides the event `uid` only when the plugin defines one. The default `shellplug` and `urlplug` plugins do not define a `uid`, so the event-controlled identity survives into child-process launch. On a root-daemon installation, this lets a low-privileged user run jobs as arbitrary users, including root, bypassing the otherwise administrator-only run-as-user control. This API-side event injection is distinct from the job-output `uid`/`gid` injection addressed by CVE-2026-39401. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.121.
detail_original.kind: 动态确定对象属性修改的控制不恰当
detail_original.kind_en: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes
